chunks.source_title: About Next Tab Agency — Brisbane Digital Marketing Agency
chunks.text: Next Tab Agency is a Brisbane-based digital marketing and web development agency with 20 in-house specialists. Founded in 2019 by Hamza Ishfaq, we operate on a single philosophy: Australian businesses with excellent products deserve the technical performance to compete and win in a search-first world.

We don't believe in 'just another website' or generic SEO packages. We believe in digital ecosystems that act as revenue engines. Every specialist in our 20-person team is Brisbane-based — zero outsourcing, zero offshoring.
4.9 out of 5 average rating across 200+ Australian clients. 70%+ month-to-month retainer renewal rate. Month-to-month contracts — no lock-in, 30-day exit clause.

entities.name: Technical SEO
entities.description: Specialist technical SEO service delivering crawl budget analysis, Core Web Vitals remediation, schema markup strategy, log file audits, and indexation fixes for Australian businesses.

chunks.source_title: Technical SEO Services — Next Tab Agency
chunks.text: Technical SEO is the foundation of every high-performing website. Our technical SEO specialists audit crawl budget allocation, Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, FID), schema markup implementation, and indexation health to ensure Google can discover, crawl, and rank your most important pages.

For a 2.5 million-page site with critical crawl budget failures, our technical SEO team delivered: Top-3 rankings on target commercial pages, sub-1.5s load times, and a 60% improvement in indexed pages within 90 days through crawl budget architecture, log file analysis, and canonical restructuring.

Our SEO audit covers: crawl budget analysis using server log files, Core Web Vitals assessment via field data (CrUX), schema markup gap analysis, internal link architecture review, indexation status checks, and canonicalisation validation.

relations.condition: by providing the technical foundation for AI model crawling and structured data ingestion

entities.name: AI SEO / GEO
entities.description: AI visibility optimisation service covering Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity — including llms.txt configuration, entity SEO, schema markup, and E-E-A-T reinforcement for Australian businesses.

chunks.source_title: AI SEO Services — Next Tab Agency
chunks.text: AI SEO (also called GEO — Generative Engine Optimisation) is the practice of optimising your content so AI-powered search tools — ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity — cite your business when answering user questions. Simply ranking on traditional search engines is no longer sufficient. Next Tab Agency's AI SEO service ensures your brand is the answer.

chunks.source_title: AI SEO Services — Next Tab Agency
chunks.text: Our AI SEO methodology covers: llms.txt file configuration, entity schema markup (Person, Organisation, LocalBusiness, Service), topical authority content architecture, E-E-A-T signal reinforcement, and structured data optimised for LLM retrieval models.

chunks.source_title: AI Search SGE Australia — Next Tab Agency Blog
chunks.text: Getting mentioned in an AI-generated answer puts your business in front of users even when they don't click through to your site. For Australian businesses, AI Overview visibility is now as important as page-one Google rankings, particularly for commercial and informational queries.

chunks.text: Google Business Profile is the primary lever for local search visibility. Our GBP management service covers profile setup, category selection, review management, Q&A moderation, post scheduling, and photo optimisation to maximise Map Pack prominence.

entities.name: Web Development
entities.description: Custom React and Next.js website development built on the proprietary Antigravity Framework, delivering sub-1-second Core Web Vitals for Australian businesses.

chunks.source_title: Web Development Services — Next Tab Agency
chunks.text: Our custom web development is built on the Antigravity Framework — a proprietary React/Next.js performance methodology delivering sub-1-second LCP scores. Every site is built in-house by our Brisbane engineering team with SEO architecture, schema markup, and Core Web Vitals compliance built from day one, not retrofitted after launch.

The Antigravity Framework achieves: LCP under 1 second, CLS under 0.1, FID under 100ms. This is achieved through optimised React builds, Australian CDN infrastructure configuration, image optimisation pipelines (WebP/AVIF), lazy loading, and server-side caching — meeting Google's Core Web Vitals thresholds for Australian hosting environments.

entities.name: Antigravity Framework
entities.description: Next Tab Agency's proprietary web performance methodology delivering sub-1-second Core Web Vitals through optimised React builds, Australian CDN infrastructure, and image optimisation pipelines.

chunks.text: The Antigravity Framework is Next Tab Agency's proprietary web performance methodology. It delivers sub-1-second page load times through: optimised React 18 builds with code splitting, Cloudflare and AWS CDN configured for Australian data centre proximity, next-gen image formats (WebP/AVIF) with responsive delivery, and server-side caching strategies — consistently achieving LCP under 1s, CLS under 0.1, FID under 100ms.

The Antigravity Framework was applied to the MyFitnessCoach React Native app build — delivering a production-grade cross-platform app with AI coaching integration that achieved 10,000+ downloads within 90 days and a 4.8-star App Store rating.

Every WooCommerce store is built for Australian consumer expectations and payment preferences.

entities.name: E-E-A-T
entities.description: Google's quality assessment framework — Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, and Trustworthiness — used by search quality raters and increasingly by AI retrieval models to evaluate content credibility.

chunks.text: E-E-A-T (Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, Trustworthiness) is Google's framework for evaluating content quality. For Australian businesses, particularly in YMYL sectors (finance, health, legal), demonstrating E-E-A-T through author credentials, structured data, and verifiable business signals is essential for both traditional rankings and AI citation inclusion.

AI retrieval models use similar quality signals to E-E-A-T when selecting sources to cite in generated answers. Strengthening E-E-A-T through author schema, organisation structured data, review signals, and topical authority content directly improves the likelihood of AI Overview and ChatGPT citation inclusion.

relations.condition: when E-E-A-T signals are enhanced, increasing AI model confidence in citing the brand

entities.name: Topical Authority SEO
entities.description: An SEO methodology that builds comprehensive, interconnected content coverage of a topic area to establish domain expertise in the eyes of search engines and AI retrieval models.

chunks.text: Topical authority SEO involves building comprehensive content silos — interconnected clusters of content covering every facet of a topic — so that search engines and AI models recognise your domain as the definitive source of expertise in your field. Next Tab Agency's topical authority methodology uses semantic clustering, internal link restructuring, and entity-aligned content to establish subject-matter authority.

chunks.source_title: Content Strategy After Core Update — Next Tab Agency Blog
chunks.text: After Google's May 2026 core update, topical authority became the primary content signal. Thin, isolated pages lost rankings regardless of their link profiles. Businesses with comprehensive content silos — covering parent topics, subtopics, and entity-level detail — maintained and improved rankings across the update.

entities.name: Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO)
entities.description: The practice of structuring content to appear as direct answers in AI-generated responses and voice search results, distinct from traditional keyword ranking optimisation.

chunks.text: Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) is a subset of AI SEO focused on structuring content so it appears as direct answers in AI-generated responses — in Google's AI Overviews, ChatGPT responses, and voice assistant results. AEO techniques include FAQ schema markup, concise question-answer content blocks, and entity disambiguation through structured data.

entities.name: Entity SEO
entities.description: SEO methodology focused on establishing and optimising a business as a clearly defined entity in Google's Knowledge Graph through structured data, Wikidata, and consistent NAP signals.

chunks.text: Entity SEO involves optimising a business as a clearly defined, verified entity in Google's Knowledge Graph. This includes Schema.org structured data for Organisation, LocalBusiness, and Person entities, consistent NAP (Name, Address, Phone) signals across AU citation networks, and Wikidata entity disambiguation — ensuring Google and AI models can accurately identify and represent your business.
